snippet.title: No Wings Required - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy. No Wings Required will be available on PC via Steam.
